title: Weather and seasons
description: Talk about rain, sun, heat and cold, and say how the weather makes you feel.

guide.title: Weather is a noun that comes or is there
guide.text:
English says 'it is raining'. Kannada has no 'it' here: the weather itself is the subject. Rain 'comes'; sun, cold, heat and cloud 'are there'.

ಮಳೆ (male) rain: male barutte (rain comes = it rains), male bartide (it is raining), male bantu (it rained), male nintide (the rain has stopped).
ಬಿಸಿಲು (bisilu) sunshine, heat of the sun: bisilu ide, 'it is sunny'.
ಚಳಿ (chali) cold: chali ide, 'it is cold'.
ಸೆಕೆ (seke) heat, sultriness: seke ide, 'it is hot'.
ಗಾಳಿ (gaali) wind, air: gaali beesutte, 'the wind blows'.
ಮೋಡ (moda) cloud: moda ide, 'it is cloudy'.
ಮಂಜು (manju) mist, fog, dew.

For what the weather is generally like in a place or season, use irutte ('is, as a rule') instead of ide: besigeyalli seke irutte, 'it is hot in summer'.

guide.title: Feeling hot and cold
guide.text:
How the weather feels to you uses the dative pattern with aagu, 'happen': ನನಗೆ ಚಳಿ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ (nanage chali aagtide), 'cold is happening to me' = 'I am feeling cold'; nanage seke aagtide, 'I am feeling hot'.

Do not say naanu chali or naanu bisi for 'I am cold / hot'.

ಬಿಸಿ (bisi) 'hot' and ತಣ್ಣಗೆ (tannage) 'cold' describe things you touch or eat - coffee, water, food - not the weather. ತಂಪು (tampu) is 'pleasantly cool': tampaagide, 'it is nice and cool'.

ಹವಾಮಾನ (havaamaana) and ವಾತಾವರಣ (vaataavarana) both mean 'weather, climate'; many people simply say 'vedar'.

guide.title: Seasons
guide.text:
Karnataka has three main seasons, each named with ಕಾಲ (kaala), 'time, season':

ಬೇಸಿಗೆ (besige) or ಬೇಸಿಗೆ ಕಾಲ, summer - roughly March to May.
ಮಳೆಗಾಲ (malegaala), the rainy season or monsoon - June to September or October.
ಚಳಿಗಾಲ (chaligaala), winter - November to February.

(kaala becomes -gaala when joined to male and chali.)

'In summer' takes the locative: besigeyalli; malegaaladalli; chaligaaladalli.

Bengaluru is known for its mild weather, and remarking on it is a safe way to start any conversation.

examples.english: It is very hot in summer.
In winter there is mist in the morning.

phrases.note: bisilu is the heat and light of the sun.
Another word for umbrella is kode (ಕೊಡೆ).

phrases.english: The weather in Bengaluru is nice.
It is very hot in summer.
phrases.note: irutte for what is generally true. Written: iruttade (ಇರುತ್ತದೆ).

phrases.english: In winter there is mist in the morning.

phrases.note: The o of moda is long.
